exercises.instruction: Complete the names of these rooms in a house.
items: 1 The .......................... room (also called the ..........................) is where people watch TV.
2 The .......................... room is where people eat meals.
4 The .......................... is where people wash or have a bath.
5 The .......................... room is for occasional guests, and often for storing things.
